method: As on 2026-10-25, 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-01: each board page read, its benchmarkViewUrl prop's hashed /_astro/benchmark_view_*.json downloaded (vals/<stem>.json, URL in vals/<stem>.jsonUrl.txt); values from tasks.overall.<model key>. Exact = same Vals model key (model version) and reasoning_effort/compute_effort equal to AA's effort, or, where AA plots no effort, the documented or owner-stated equivalent (O149 MiMo-V2.6-Flash); absent otherwise. The Vibe Code Bench leaf is v1.1.1 (owner decision 2026-11-26; Vals archived v1.1): the 'vibe-code' board's coverage holds v1.1.1 values, each cell stating version v1.1.1, and the v1.1 values are in that board's predecessorReference, never in coverage. Code Migration stays v1.1. Vals model pages read 2026-11-26 in vals/_models/ (read 2026-11-26T03:05:37Z; MiMo-V2.6-Pro page 2026-11-26T03:14:51Z).

Vals records reasoning, reasoning_effort and compute_effort as null; its MiMo-V2.6-Pro model page (vals/_models/xiaomi_mimo-v2.6-pro.html, re-read 2026-11-26), in its 2026-09-22 update covering both MiMo V2.6 models, still says 'We evaluated them with reasoning enabled' through the official Xiaomi API, so the record is the thinking-enabled configuration (owner decision O149, 2026-11-01). The v1.1.1 row has the same cost per test as the v1.1 row (v1.1.1 re-grades the v1.1 runs), so the setting the model page describes applies to it.

versionStatus.bannerText: Vibe Code Bench v1.1 has been superseded by v1.1.1, which upgrades the grader, requires every substep to pass, and fixes ambiguous tests. Previous results are preserved here.

predecessorReference.whatChanged: Vals' banner on v1.1: 'superseded by v1.1.1, which upgrades the grader, requires every substep to pass, and fixes ambiguous tests'. Of the 51 model keys on both versions, 51 have identical cost per test (the runs look reused and re-graded) and the accuracy falls by 0.7 to 25.7 points (mean 14.7).
predecessorReference.valuesNote: The v1.1 value and stderr of every cohort configuration that matched exactly on v1.1 (the same exact-effort rule as v1.1.1). Reference only.
